basalt.notes: Configured by server.port in etc/basalt/basalt_config.json; the service also passes --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18012. Upstream default is 8080.

gufo.notes: Set with --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18001 in the service block. Upstream default is 8080.

gufetto.notes: Set with --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18002 in the service block. Upstream default is 8080.

gufo-franzmoca.notes: Set with --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18003 in the service block. Upstream default is 8080.

strixite.notes: Configured by host/port in etc/strixite/strix_server.conf and overridden explicitly with --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18004 in the service block. Upstream default is 5300.

project-maya.notes: Set with --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18005 in the service block. maya-server upstream default is 8080.

strata.notes: Port changed to 18006 in the existing strata-cli service invocation. The launcher and server default to 127.0.0.1; that command shape exposes no --host flag, so this service relies on the default loopback bind.

rocmfpx.notes: Set with --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18007 in the service block. Serves the bundled llama-server endpoint.

stable-diffusion-cpp.notes: Set with --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18008 in the service block. Upstream default is 8080.

zinc.notes: Set with --port 18009. Upstream has no --host flag and always binds 0.0.0.0, so the registry bind_host cannot be enforced for this service; use a host firewall or an isolating network namespace.

kyojin.notes: Set with --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18010 in the service block; the service starts the qwen engine. Upstream default is 8000.

hipfire.notes: Set with the documented positional bind 127.0.0.1:18011; hipfire serve has no --port flag. Upstream default is 11435.

shimmy.notes: Set with --host 127.0.0.1 --port 11434 in the service block. Retained because 11434 is the upstream/Ollama-compatible default.

hyperqwen.notes: Set explicitly to 18020 through HYPERQWEN_PORT in the service block; the wrapper passes the value to vLLM with --host 127.0.0.1 --port. Upstream default is 18020.
